module_specification.purpose: Deterministic graph slicing (Read Corridor vs. Write Mutation DAG), utility/logger noise pruning, and cross-corridor blast radius calculation using petgraph and blake3 signature hashes.

parameters.mutation_weight_zero: Node performs no DB writes, no domain entity transformations, and returns void or primitive formatting strings.

utility_noise_score.exception_rule: Never prune a node if it owns a Contract Type/Interface directly referenced in the Entry Gate or Target Symbol signature.

contagion_index.description: Counts exact number of symbols/files outside the active corridor slice that import or implement a contract defined in node v.

steps: 1. Locate Entry Gate Node (e.g., HTTP Controller method) in the global Semantic Graph.
2. Run Breadth-First Search (BFS) along Outgoing Edges (Call, Instantiate, MutateState, TypeReference).
3. At each visited node, evaluate PruneFilter::should_prune(node, graph).
4. If pruned, drop node and do not traverse its outgoing edges.
5. Construct induced subgraph of surviving nodes.
6. Break cycles using Tarjan's Strongly Connected Components (SCC) condensation and compute topological order.
7. Attach immediate Contract Definitions (Interfaces/DTOs) to each execution step.

write_mutation_backward_slice.direction: Bottom-Up (Mutated Contract/Symbol -> Upstream Dependents within Corridor + External Blast Radius)
steps: 1. Identify Target Node(s) where the contract or logic change starts.
2. Compute Forward Slice from Entry Gate to establish the active Corridor Boundary.
3. From Target Node, traverse Incoming Edges (reverse dependencies: Who calls or implements this?).
4. Partition discovered dependents into TWO sets: Internal Corridor Nodes (in-scope for sequential editing) and External Nodes (out-of-scope Blast Radius).
5. Sort Internal Corridor Nodes in Reverse Topological Order (Contract/Schema first -> Service second -> Controller last).
6. Attach External Nodes to the BlastRadiusReport of the specific Gate where the shared contract is mutated.

target_files.description: Core semantic graph structures, node/edge types, and petgraph indices mapping.
Deterministic noise filtering engine that identifies and strips loggers, telemetry, and high-fan-in pure utilities.
Implements Forward Read Corridor Slicing, Backward Mutation DAG Slicing, Topological Sorting, and Contagion/Blast Radius calculation.
